A '''[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]''' who served under [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Trap/Legends|Trap]] in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]] as part of the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']]{{'s}} crew during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWBI" />

==Biography==
Shortly after the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], this clone trooper was aboard the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']] commanded by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] during a medical supply run to a station near [[Ord Cestus]].<ref name="TCWBI" />

Unbeknownst to him, [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worms]] had been brought aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]], and these worms soon infected the entire crew save the Jedi. He was the final uninfected [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] left on the ship, falling victim to the parasites when the other possessed troopers trapped him in a cargo room. The clones [[Scythe]] and [[Edge/Legends|Edge]] pinned him down, while [[Havoc (clone trooper)/Legends|Havoc]] took one of the brain worms and infected him, a scene witnessed by the horrified Ahsoka and Barriss. Later, after Ahsoka discovered that the worms could be killed by frost, she ruptured the ship's cooling tanks, curing this clone trooper and the rest of the crew.<ref name="TCWBI" />
